_comment: Benign / positive / neutral customer turns that must NOT trigger objection coaching. Measures PRECISION — the gap that let F20's false-positive regression ship (recall-only eval stayed green while benign turns fired objection advice). A turn here 'fires' if classifyHeuristic marks it isObjection, i.e. it would bypass the urgency gate into objection-first retrieval. Questions are excluded on purpose (a question legitimately invites a coached answer; the output relevance gate handles those).
